_doc: Zones for the Koi Blossom FR size-M trial crop (x -220..-50, y 30..300 garment mm; x from CF, + = wearer's left; y from the CF neck seam). Hand-authored on 20 Oct 2026 (engine trial, tag koi) from the 12 ppm reference (mockup + fr_upper close-up) and its tone trace. A zone is a WINDOW plus the tones that belong to it: what a region IS, never its shape; silhouettes are traced from the input pixels (LESSONS A14). Lily zones also carry a `heart` window (where the flower's heart is; its centre is read from the stamen pixels inside it). Zones claim pixels from the highest z down; there is NO rest zone: the navy duck between motifs is bare (run.yaml threads.bare).

zones.note: close-up fish 2 (the long one under the lily)
close-up fish 3 (bottom right), its snout at the crop edge
the big upper lily (close-up lily 0); its left petals run out of the close-up and the crop
the deep-navy stems under the lilies (branch columns where they read as strokes)
leaves around the lilies and the floating petals: clumps fanning along their long axis from their stem (or their base)
